heading_text_en: (12) International application published under the Patent Cooperation Treaty
notes: WIPO front page: publication/application numbers, dates, IPC, applicants, inventors, designated states, title. Lines 6 and 8 are the two IMAGE_EXTRACT spans of the front-page abstract scheme (IV -> V and IV -> VIII); the vision pass placed them above the bibliographic text rather than beside the abstract at 44-47, so they are kept with the surrounding text here rather than opening a section at an image.
English abstract at 44-45 and Chinese abstract at 46-47. The abstract's own reaction drawings were transcribed at lines 6 and 8 and sit in the bibliographic section.

Lines 49-54 are the p02 page comment plus the description running head (说明书) and the repeated invention title; they are page furniture and are folded into the section that follows them. The field statement itself is [0001] at 57-58.

Two prior-art routes drawn in full: DE19846792A1 (line 65, 11 steps) and CN 200510030163.5 (line 74, 11 steps). Counted as 22 because they are two separate schemes, but they overlap heavily: only the first step (dichlorotoluene + CH3SNa vs diazotisation of 3-chloro-2-methylaniline) and three reagent choices (NBS vs Br2, oxalyl chloride vs SOCl2) differ. If A2 dedupes across the two schemes it will report closer to 12.

Numbered aspects (1) to (11), [0008]-[0030], each carrying its scheme as an IMAGE_EXTRACT. The eight distinct transformations are (i) VI->I, (ii) I->II, (iii) II->III, (iv) III->IV, (v) IV->V, (v') IV->VIII, (vi) V->tembotrione, (vi') IV->tembotrione. Aspect (9) at 160-173 defines formula (A) and its R1/R2 combinations; it is left here rather than split out because it is one item in a numbered list of aspects.
Captions for Figures 1-16, [0031]-[0046]. All sixteen are 1H or 13C NMR spectra.

Opens 具体实施方式. [0047]-[0053] give the general formula (A), the four R1/R2 combinations, and the explicit list of compounds (I)-(IV) as an IMAGE_EXTRACT at 233. Split from the route text that follows because the subject matter changes from defining the claimed compounds to preparing them; the 具体实施方式 heading itself has no second heading marking that change, so the boundary at 234/235 is a judgement call taken at [0053]/[0054].

Second half of 具体实施方式, [0054]-[0104]. Generic (unquantified) procedures with temperature ranges, solvents, catalysts and molar ratios for: VI->I ([0055]-[0058]), the known preparation of VI ([0059]), I->II ([0061]-[0066]), II->III ([0068]-[0073]), III->IV ([0075]-[0080]), IV->V carbonylation (v-1) ([0081]-[0089]), IV->VIII direct carbonylation (v'-1) ([0090], [0092]), and VIII->tembotrione rearrangement ([0091], line 348). No type in the closed list names a CN detailed-description block; summary_of_invention is the closest fit because the content is the technical solution and its key parameters, and the quantity-free procedures make it clearly not experimental.

heading_text_zh: 实施例1 式(VI)化合物的制备
heading_text_en: Example 1 Preparation of the compound of formula (VI)
notes: Lines 422-423 are the bare 实施例 (Examples) lead-in heading; it is folded into Example 1 rather than given its own section. 3-chloro-2-methylaniline -> diazonium -> compound (VI) with CH3SNa, run as one telescoped operation. HPLC conditions at 435 and NMR figure references at 437 belong to this preparation, not to a separate assay section.

heading_text_zh: 实施例2 式(I)化合物的制备
heading_text_en: Example 2 Preparation of the compound of formula (I)
notes: Bromination of (VI) with 98.4 g bromine in dichloromethane.

heading_text_zh: 实施例3 式(II)化合物的制备
heading_text_en: Example 3 Preparation of the compound of formula (II)
notes: Sulfide -> sulfone oxidation with 23% hydrogen peroxide, sodium tungstate dihydrate catalyst. Procedure runs across the p18/p19 page break at 456.

heading_text_zh: 实施例4 式(III)化合物的制备
heading_text_en: Example 4 Preparation of the compound of formula (III)
notes: Two alternative procedures for the same benzylic bromination: 方法1 with bromine/BPO/1,2-dichloroethane ([0119]) and 方法2 with NBS/BPO/carbon tetrachloride ([0120]). Counted as two because each carries its own charge list and work-up.

heading_text_zh: 实施例5 式(IV)化合物的制备
heading_text_en: Example 5 Preparation of the compound of formula (IV)
notes: Sodium trifluoroethoxide is generated in situ from 60% NaH and trifluoroethanol and then displaces the benzylic bromide. Counted as one step; A2 may reasonably split the alkoxide generation out as a second.

heading_text_zh: 实施例6 式(V)羧酸化合物的制备1
heading_text_en: Example 6 Preparation 1 of the carboxylic acid compound of formula (V)
notes: CO carbonylation of (IV) in water/triethylamine/PdCl2/dppb/1,4-dioxane, 80 C, 12 h, 81.13% yield.

heading_text_zh: 实施例7 式(V)羧酸化合物的制备2
heading_text_en: Example 7 Preparation 2 of the carboxylic acid compound of formula (V)
notes: Same carbonylation as Example 6 with dppp ligand in THF, 67.57% yield. Kept as its own example, not a comparative one: the patent presents it as an alternative rather than as a control.

heading_text_zh: 实施例8 环磺酮的制备1
notes: Three transformations in one example: (V) + SOCl2 -> acid chloride (VII); (VII) + 1,3-cyclohexanedione/triethylamine -> ester (VIII); (VIII) + acetone cyanohydrin -> tembotrione, 76.59% yield. One section per rule 6.

heading_text_zh: 实施例9 式(VIII)酯中间体的直接制备
heading_text_en: Example 9 Direct preparation of the ester intermediate of formula (VIII)
notes: 方法1 ([0138]) direct carbonylative esterification of (IV) with 1,3-cyclohexanedione under CO in dioxane; 方法2 ([0139]) the same with ethylene glycol diethyl ether, 71.63% yield. 方法2 is stated only as a solvent substitution but reports its own yield, so it is counted as a second step.

heading_text_zh: 实施例10 环磺酮的制备2(一锅法)
notes: One pot but two chemical events: carbonylation of (IV) under CO at 80-85 C for 8 h, then acetone cyanohydrin added at 70 C for a further 5 h to rearrange to tembotrione. 64.67% yield, mp 120-122 C.

Labelled 实施例 rather than 对比实施例, but it is a deliberately inferior ligand screen: SPhos or Xantphos in place of dppb gives a yield below 10%, described as 不理想 (unsatisfactory). Classified comparative_example on content per rule 9; the label disagreement is recorded here rather than resolved.

Claims 1-14 over pages p24-p29, each scheme carried as an IMAGE_EXTRACT. Same eight distinct transformations as the summary: (i)-(iv), (v), (v'), (vi), (vi'). Claim 11 is the compound claim to formula (A) and claims 13-14 are use claims.

Pages p30-p39, sheets 1/10 to 10/10: the sixteen NMR spectra of the 附图说明 section. The vision pass recovered only figure labels ([图 10]-[图 16]), the Rule 26 26.12.2023 replacement-sheet stamp and f1 (ppm) axis captions; the IMAGE_EXTRACT spans here are the small structure insets drawn on the spectra, several of which came back empty. Typed `other` rather than `description_of_drawings` because that type is the 附图说明 caption text, already section 5; no type in the closed list covers the drawing sheets themselves.

Pages p40-p45: the English PCT/ISA/210 sheets, the Chinese translation of the same, and the patent family information at p45. Citations name reagents and example numbers in other documents but carry no procedure of their own.
